windows.default_rule: The longest of 18, 10, 5 games in which at least 80% of teams (24 of 30) are ranked (have played at least that many games); 18 once most teams reach it. If no window qualifies, the shortest window.
windows.default_chosen: 18. Teams ranked by window through 2026-11-27: 5 games = 30 of 30, 10 games = 30 of 30, 18 games = 27 of 30
windows.rule: A team with fewer games than the window shows its values over the games played, with ranked = false and no rank in any sort.
windows.source_of_18: ROLLING_WINDOW_SIZE in config.R (the original ROC-AUC window test)

methods.possessions: Per team FGA - OREB + TOV + 0.44 * FTA (TOV = total turnovers incl. team turnovers); game possessions = mean of both teams' estimates.
methods.ratings: ORtg/DRtg/NetRtg = 100 * points / possessions over the window's games. season = season to date (includes the window). change = window value minus the team's value over its season games before the window (before_window, games_before_window); null with change_null_reason "too few games before this window" when the team has fewer than 5 games before the window. Ranks: 1 = best (lowest DRtg).
methods.change_baseline: Every change measured against the season (rating changes, drivers, the combined score's trend component) uses the team's season games before the window, never a season that contains the window. Fewer than 5 earlier games: null with null_reason "too few games before this window"; no fallback, nothing imputed.

model_residual.definition: Mean of actual minus logged pregame margin (team perspective) over window games with a RESOLVED LOGGED_PREGAME prediction-log row and a non-missing predicted_margin. Missing margins are skipped, never filled.
model_residual.min_games_for_rank: ceiling(0.6 * window) logged games: 3 of 5, 6 of 10, 11 of 18

methods.opponent_adjusted_form: Mean per-game net rating + 100/poss * (opponent pregame Elo strength in points [(Elo - 1500)/28] - home sign * 2.40 home-court points + (own fatigue drag - opponent fatigue drag)); fatigue from fatigue_travel_engine.R::calculate_travel_fatigue (rest, back-to-back, haversine travel, time zones, altitude).
methods.drivers: OLS of game net rating on the eight four-factor terms (eFG%, TOV%, OREB%/DREB%, FTA/FGA, for and against) over every team-game this season; each driver = coefficient x (window minus the team's games before the window) factor change; unexplained = the remainder; every driver null with null_reason when the team has fewer than 5 games before the window. Shot profile splits the offensive eFG term into rim (<= 4 ft), mid-range and 3PT attempt-share (rate) and points-per-shot (accuracy) shifts.

combined_score.formula: sum_k weight_k * z_k, z_k = cross-sectional z-score among ranked teams of: form = opponent-adjusted form, trend = net-rating change (window minus the team's games before the window), residual = model residual (needs the residual minimum), elo = Elo change across the window's games
combined_score.null_rule: Null (and unranked) when any weighted component is unavailable; components are never filled or imputed. The trend component is unavailable for a team with fewer than 5 games before the window (and for every team when fewer than 3 ranked teams have it); like a residual below its minimum, that leaves the team's combined score and rank null, with the reason in combined_score.null_reason. z-score mean and sd use only the ranked teams that have the component. A component with zero variation among those teams has z = 0, so it adds nothing to the ranking.

validation.target: each team's mean scoring margin over its next 5 games after date d
validation.metric: mean over dates of the cross-team Spearman correlation of the score at d (games through d only) with the target

current_season.reason: no dates with enough ranked teams and a full forward horizon

previous_season.note: residual component excluded: 2025-26 has no LOGGED_PREGAME margins; remaining weights rescaled to sum to 1 for this check only
residual component excluded: 2025-26 has no LOGGED_PREGAME margins; remaining weights rescaled to sum to 1 for this check only
residual component excluded: 2025-26 has no LOGGED_PREGAME margins; remaining weights rescaled to sum to 1 for this check only

validation.weight_selection: Grid over the simplex (step 0.1) of form / trend / Elo change fitted on the first half of 2025-26 dates and checked on the second half: form alone ranked first in train and test in every window (train IC 0.40-0.42, test IC 0.52-0.61); single-component ICs form 0.47-0.50, Elo change 0.29-0.31, trend 0.08-0.14. Residual weight checked on 2026-27 (window 5: 12 dates, window 10: 5 dates): adding it moved the IC by -0.04 to +0.01. Chosen weights keep form dominant and give trend, residual and Elo change 0.1 each; the owner reviews them. The grid figures above used the earlier season-including trend baseline; current_season and previous_season are re-run with the before-window baseline and the same weights.

elo.margin_multiplier: (|margin| + 3)^0.8 / (7.5 + 0.006 * winner Elo lead incl. home court)
elo.changes: change_7d / change_14d = rating on through_date minus rating 7 / 14 days earlier from the daily series; rank change positive = moved up

methods.schedule_strength: Mean current win pct of opponents faced (window and season) and of opponents scheduled in the next 7 days; rank 1 = hardest.
methods.clutch: build_clutch_dataset.R filter (4Q/OT, <= 5:00, pre-play margin <= 5). Clutch games = games with any clutch play; points from score changes on clutch plays; clutch net rating per 100 clutch possessions (same estimator on clutch events).

definitions.label: Shot quality vs actual eFG%
definitions.test: binomial z of actual eFG% against location-expected eFG% (shot_quality_engine.R baseline), n = FGA

definitions.label: Opponent 3P% vs league
definitions.test: binomial z of opponents' 3P% against the league 3P% season to date, n = opponent 3PA

definitions.label: Record vs Pythagorean expectation
definitions.test: binomial z of win% against Pythagorean win% (exponent 14) from window points, n = games

definitions.label: Clutch record vs clutch net rating
definitions.test: binomial z of clutch-game win% against the Pythagorean expectation of clutch-time points (exponent 3.81 = 14 x sqrt(league clutch points per clutch game / points per game)), n = clutch games

definitions.label: Opponent FT% vs league
definitions.test: binomial z of opponents' FT% against the league FT% season to date, n = opponent FTA

definitions.label: Record in games decided by 3 or fewer
definitions.test: binomial z of close-game win% against 0.5, n = close games

definitions.label: Signal driven by one blowout
definitions.test: z of the window's mean margin vs season-to-date mean margin, with and without the largest-|margin| game; significant when the full-window z clears 1.96 and the reduced one does not

definitions.label: Window opponent strength
definitions.test: z of the mean pregame opponent Elo against the league mean (1500), sd = league sd of pregame opponent Elo, n = games

definitions.label: Share of home and rest-advantage games
definitions.test: binomial z of home share against 0.5 and of rest-advantage share against the league rate; significant when either clears 1.96 (statistic = the larger |z|)

definitions.label: Key players missing
definitions.test: binomial z (one-sided) of key-player did-not-play rate in the window against the league key-player rate; key player = >= 10% of team minutes in games played and >= 3 games

definitions.label: Rotation minutes shift vs season
definitions.test: total variation distance of window vs season minutes shares; z (one-sided) across teams with a full window

flags.badge_rule: Show a badge only when significant is true; raw value and statistic always present (null with null_reason when not computable).
flags.significance: |z| >= 1.96 (two-sided 5%); flags 10 and 11 one-sided (z >= 1.96). Binomial z = (k/n - p0) / sqrt(p0 (1 - p0) / n) and Empirical Bayes value_shrunk = (k + 15 p0) / (n + 15) - p0, the shots pipeline's machinery (web/lib/shotChartUtils.ts); z is not computed below n = 4.
flags.availability_source: Flags 10 and 11 come from player box did_not_play rows and minutes (coverage 100.0% of panel games); the injury cache is a current snapshot with no history and is not used.

rank_history.rule: One snapshot per Monday-start week (latest run in the week); history starts at launch, no backfill. rank_7d_ago and rank_change_7d are recomputed from games through 7 days earlier; when null, rank_7d_ago_null_reason / rank_change_7d_null_reason say why (no games by then, not ranked then, or no current rank).

methods.nulls: Unsupported values are null with a null_reason; nothing is imputed or synthesised.
